title: Govt of Singapore’s India portfolio: 10 stocks rally up to 100% in FY27 so far
raw_summary: The Government of Singapore (GoS) maintains a significant presence in the Indian stock market and ranks among the major foreign institutional investors (FIIs) by portfolio value. According to its latest shareholding disclosures for the September 2026 quarter, GoS held stakes in 36 Indian listed companies, with a combined market value of approximately Rs 1,26,299 crore as of October 24, 2026. This marks a decline of nearly 24% from its portfolio value of Rs 1,65,129 crore in March 2026.In terms of stock performance, around 14 stocks in the portfolio have delivered positive returns so far in FY27, while nearly half have posted negative returns. We highlight the top 10 performers, whose shares have gained between 20% and 100%. We also look at six stocks that were newly added to the portfolio in the September quarter. (Data Source: ACE Equity, Trendlyne)
